ai_summary: Avonmore Capital & Management Services Ltd., an NBFC and holding company, has approved the amalgamation of four wholly-owned subsidiaries into the parent company, aiming to simplify its corporate structure and reduce operational costs without altering its shareholding pattern. While this streamlines operations, the negative turnover reported by two of the merging subsidiaries (Apricot Infosoft and Avonmore Developer) for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, is a notable financial detail that warrants scrutiny for its potential impact on the consolidated entity's future performance.
